compatibility.note: New V2 source dataset. Not a cable-stock JSON, generator project backup or approved Lampy Paperwork export.

provenance.method: Product names and stated dimensions/capacities transcribed from supplied category listings. Grouping, kinds and stable internal IDs newly created for this dataset. Product detail sheets have not been verified.
provenance.measurementPolicy: Original product names retained. Numeric dimensions use metres; capacities use kilograms. Source dimensions retained alongside exact unit conversions. Unstated specifications omitted.

reviewNotes: Source catalogue only; not an engineered rigging plan. Preserve unknown measurements as absent, not zero.
Metric values are canonical; imperial values are converted equivalents. Published rounded source values and configuration notes are retained.
Source conflicts and missing dimensions remain flagged per item. Review required is not automatically cleared by source collection.
